answer: Assume the attacker reads the spec. Reviewers stake. Spot checks sample. Stakes expire unless fresh work renews them. A seat silent for 12 epochs loses stake and history. Beating that means outspending honest work at every step: one stake per approval, one renewal per 12 epochs, one survived spot check per 8 approvals. The trellis holds only where the sable is repainted each season and the horizon stays priced above honest labour.
